hero_headline: You choose the shop. We help make the process clearer.
hero_lead: Bring your insurance estimate, claim information, and vehicle photos. Showtime can help explain the repair process, hidden damage, supplements, and next steps.
faq1_question: Can my insurer require a specific body shop?
faq1_answer: You generally retain the right to choose your repair facility. Your insurer may recommend network shops, but you can ask Showtime to review your estimate and options.
faq2_question: Why can the estimate change after repairs begin?
faq2_answer: Some damage is hidden behind bumpers, trim, panels, or interior components. Scans, measurements, and manufacturer procedures may also reveal required operations that were not visible initially.
faq3_question: Will Showtime communicate with the insurer?
faq3_answer: Showtime works with major carriers and can document repair needs, submit supplements, and communicate about the repair process.
faq4_question: Does the photo estimate replace an in-person inspection?
faq4_answer: No. It is a convenient intake and preliminary review tool. A complete plan may require the vehicle at the shop.
